interpretation: Oracle risk-coverage curves read at many alpha. The curve is alpha-free: max_acceptance_by_alpha is one fixed object read at different heights, so this introduces no new statistic, no threshold selection and no multiplicity. It is an UPPER bound on what any threshold rule could achieve, which is the only direction it is used in: where the floor is unreachable here, no certificate at that alpha could have cleared it. The frozen headline target remains alpha=0.20 and NO certificate is issued at any alpha on this curve.
